# Hopper Tweaks v1.0.1

Works out of the box on a fresh install — including with lithium installed.

## What changed

- **Automatic lithium compatibility.** The mod now declares a
  `lithium:options` override (`mixin.block.hopper = false`) in its
  `fabric.mod.json`, using lithium's official mod-override mechanism.
  Lithium disables only its hopper optimization (which replaces the vanilla
  transfer code this mod hooks) and logs it as `added by mods [hoppertweaks]`.
  No manual configuration is needed anymore. If a user explicitly sets
  `mixin.block.hopper = true` in lithium's config, their choice wins.

## Verified

Fresh dedicated servers (default lithium config, no manual edits) with
lithium + Hopper Tweaks installed:

- **1.21.11** (lithium 0.21.4): `/hopperspeed 10` → hopper moved exactly
  10 items per cycle (64 → 4 remaining after 6 cycles; chest +60).
- **26.2** (lithium 0.25.3): same test → exactly 10 items per cycle
  (chest +50 after 5 cycles).

All artifacts from v1.0.0 remain compatible; this is a metadata-only change
plus documentation.

releases.notes:
# Hopper Tweaks v1.0.0

The first release of Hopper Tweaks — a Fabric mod that makes the hopper
transfer amount configurable, per world, with a command or a Mod Menu config
screen.

## Features

- **Configurable transfer amount** — hoppers move up to 64 items per cycle
  instead of the vanilla 1 (`/hopperspeed <1-64>`).
- **Per world** — the value is stored in `hoppertweaks.properties` inside each
  world's save folder and restored on the next start. `/hopperspeed` without
  arguments prints the current world's value.
- **Stack aware** — a transfer never exceeds the source stack or the free
  space of the destination, so a nearly full container simply receives what
  fits and partial inserts behave cleanly.
- **Composter exception** — pushing into composters always stays at the
  vanilla speed of one item per cycle.
- **Carpet compatible** — hopper counter lines keep draining; every real
  transfer fully succeeds, so counters always see correct amounts.
- **Carpet TIS Addition compatible** — the `hopperNoItemCost` rule and the
  `/scounter` logger count the exact transferred amount, also for partial
  inserts into nearly full containers.
- **Config screen** — edit the running world's speed from Mod Menu
  (Cloth Config). The bundled logo shows up in the mod list.

## Requirements (all versions)

- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config (for the config screen)
- Optional: Mod Menu for the config button

> If lithium is installed, set `mixin.block.hopper = false` in
> `config/lithium.properties`. Lithium's hopper optimization replaces the
> vanilla transfer code this mod modifies; all other lithium optimizations
> stay active.

| 26.1.1      | 25   | `mc/26.1.1`  | `hopper-tweaks-1.0.0+mc26.1.1.jar`    |
